name: Erin Michelle Dalton

public.text:
I’m Erin Michelle Dalton, 44, and I work as an administrative coordinator at a community health clinic in Portland. Outside work, I enjoy practical, low-key interests. My top 10 are:
1. Reading long-form nonfiction and narrative journalism
2. Public health and community health programs
3. Cooking simple, healthy meals and baking
4. Planning trips to historic cities, especially in Europe
5. Walking and spending time outdoors
6. Gardening herbs on my balcony
7. Local civic issues, including transit and neighborhood planning
8. Small music shows and cultural events
9. Health policy podcasts and approachable history shows
10. Home organizing and modest improvement projects

My propensity to purchase bottled gazpacho is 3 out of 5. I’d be open to trying it, since the vegetable ingredients and Mediterranean style appeal to me, but a cold blended soup isn’t part of my usual routine. Price, taste, and the nutrition label would matter; I’m not sure it would become a regular buy.

justification: I’d be open to trying it, since the vegetable ingredients and Mediterranean style appeal to me, but a cold blended soup isn’t part of my usual routine. Price, taste, and the nutrition label would matter; I’m not sure it would become a regular buy.
